      private ThermalState(double[] temperature, double[] enthalpy, double[] mass, String[] signatures, double[] structure)
      Copies the thermal state and its fixed-inventory assumptions.
      Parameters:
      temperature - fluid and wall temperatures
      enthalpy - fluid specific enthalpies
      mass - nominal fixed fluid masses
      signatures - composition and pressure identities
      structure - wall and nominal-volume parameters
